## Checklist

- [ ] Targets `development` (or `main` only for a release/hotfix PR).
- [ ] Lint, unit tests, and build pass locally.
- [ ] Tests added or updated for changed logic.
- [ ] No secrets, API keys, real financial data, or credentials in code, logs, or screenshots.
- [ ] Sensitive data is encrypted before reaching Firestore.
- [ ] Firestore rules updated and emulator-tested if the data model changed.
- [ ] Works on Firebase Spark plan (no Blaze-only services).
- [ ] Docs updated (`docs/`, ADR for architectural decisions, `CHANGELOG.md`).
